name: Central Digital Library & Resource Center
description: Fully automated central library offering expansive reading rooms, online public access catalog (OPAC), digital manuscripts, research cubicles, and subscription to international journals.

name: Advanced Science & Biotechnology Complex
description: State-of-the-art laboratory complex supporting undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral research in Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Physics, and Organic Chemistry.

name: Central Computer Labs & IT Infrastructure
description: Dedicated computer centers equipped with modern desktop workstations, licensed software development suites, cloud programming tools, and high-speed campus fiber Wi-Fi.

name: Commerce & Management Business Lab
tagline: Stock Market Simulation · Corporate Case Study Desk
description: Interactive business laboratory designed for Commerce and Management scholars to gain practical insights into stock exchange trading, GST filling, financial software, and corporate filing.

name: Postgraduate Conference Hall & Auditorium
description: Spacious auditorium and air-conditioned seminar halls hosting national conferences, guest lectures, cultural festivals, inter-collegiate fests, and convocation ceremonies.

name: Campus Chapel
description: Historic, serene chapel situated at the center of the campus quadrangle, providing a tranquil sanctuary for prayer, quiet reflection, and spiritual nourishment.

name: Indoor Stadium & Sports Infrastructure
description: Comprehensive sports infrastructure including a spacious indoor stadium with wooden badminton courts, table tennis, gymnasium, and expansive outdoor grounds for cricket, football, and athletics.

name: St. Philomena's Girls Hostel
tagline: Secure Campus Living · Resident Warden Supervision
description: On-campus residential facility offering comfortable rooms, hygienic mess dining, 24/7 security surveillance, study halls, and recreational lounges for female scholars.

name: St. Philomena's Boys Hostel
description: Residential hall providing safe and structured living for outstation male students with nutritious dining, study areas, and direct access to campus sports grounds.

name: Bank Branch & 24/7 ATM Facility
description: On-campus full-fledged bank branch and 24/7 ATM machine providing hassle-free fee payments, scholarship withdrawals, and everyday banking services for students and staff.

name: NCC (Army & Naval Wings) & NSS Units
description: Active National Cadet Corps (Army & Naval units) and National Service Scheme (NSS) divisions conducting Republic Day parades, social camps, blood donation drives, and disaster relief training.
